C1465.title: ICS Vulnerabilities Expose Industrial Enterprises' Lack of Emergency Response Capabilities
keywords: National Industrial Information Security Development and Research Center
C1465.summary: In May 2018, media reported that industrial control system vulnerabilities were frequent in China and that some systems lacked protection and were directly connected to networks, allowing attackers to affect industrial control device operation and threaten production safety. The current references are insufficient to verify specific monitoring data from the national industrial information security research institution or the figure that about 70% of inspected industrial enterprises lacked complete disaster response systems; original reports should be added before including those numbers.

references.title: Rampant Information Security Vulnerabilities: Industrial Control Systems Exposed Online
